definitions.explanation: A shape with four sides and four angles.

examples.notes: [Note: 四角い is the i-adjective form]

examples.japanese: この{箱|はこ}は{四角|しかく}い{形|かたち}をしているので、{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねやすい。
examples.english: This box has a square shape, so it's easy to stack.

notes:
{四角|しかく} is a general term for any four-sided shape — squares, rectangles, and other quadrilaterals. It is the everyday word; for precise geometric terms, see below.

FORMS:
- {四角|しかく} (noun): a square/rectangle
- {四角|しかく}い (i-adjective): square-shaped, boxy — the most natural adjectival form
- {四角|しかく}な (na-adjective): less common in everyday speech

PRECISE GEOMETRIC TERMS:
- {正方形|せいほうけい}: square (all sides equal)
- {長方形|ちょうほうけい}: rectangle
- {四角形|しかくけい}: quadrilateral (formal/mathematical)

RELATED SHAPES:
- {三角|さんかく}: triangle
- {丸|まる}: circle
- {丸|まる}い: round (i-adjective)

USAGE:
In everyday conversation, {四角|しかく}い is used broadly to describe anything boxy or rectangular: {四角|しかく}い{箱|はこ} (square box), {四角|しかく}い{顔|かお} (square face).
